name: Emilio Treviño
bio: Emilio Rafael Treviño Villagómez is a Mexican film, dubbing, theater and television actor, famous for his work as Miles Morales from Spider-Man: Into the Spiderverse in the Latin dubbing. He is a graduate of the Lee Strasberg Film and Theater Institute in New York.
